harness.name: Claude Code CLI
harness.surface: claude -p --tools "" --setting-sources "" --strict-mcp-config --system-prompt <minimal> --output-format json (prompt piped byte-exact via stdin)
harness.notes: Fresh non-interactive invocation with a minimal replacement system prompt and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1; no tools, skills, hooks, MCP servers, CLAUDE.md, or memory in context. This CLI version also injects an environment block (cwd, OS, git status) and the account email, which cannot be disabled (~674-token bare context probe vs 253 on 2.1.214).

billing.note: Claude subscription invocation; total_cost_usd is the CLI's pricing estimate, not a separate API charge.

error: claude reported is_error: API Error: Claude's response exceeded the 128000 output token maximum. To configure this behavior, set the CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS environment variable.
